diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says SDO, datasheet reading says 3V3
diffs.evidence: Vendor front photo of the exact modelled board (Amazon B0F3JWY1XF, QUAINTBYTE, 71tIMEytkaL) shows the silkscreen: top row left-to-right 'SDO', [label partly covered by an SMD resistor], 'SCL', 'CS'; bottom row left-to-right 'INT', 'FSY', 'GND', '3V3'. The part numbers the top row as pins 1-4 and the bottom row as pins 5-8, matching this photo. The second reading's order (3V3, GND, SCL, SDA, SDO, CS, INT, FSY) was a guess from search-snippet text (manuals.plus was blocked) and does not match the silkscreen. Top row pin 1 is printed 'SDO' (3V3 is printed at bottom row, far right = pin 8).

diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says SDA, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: Vendor front photo of the exact modelled board (Amazon B0F3JWY1XF, QUAINTBYTE, 71tIMEytkaL) shows the silkscreen: top row left-to-right 'SDO', [label partly covered by an SMD resistor], 'SCL', 'CS'; bottom row left-to-right 'INT', 'FSY', 'GND', '3V3'. The part numbers the top row as pins 1-4 and the bottom row as pins 5-8, matching this photo. The second reading's order (3V3, GND, SCL, SDA, SDO, CS, INT, FSY) was a guess from search-snippet text (manuals.plus was blocked) and does not match the silkscreen. Top row pin 2's label is partly hidden by a resistor, but the other seven pads are clearly printed SDO, SCL, CS, INT, FSY, GND, 3V3, so the only remaining board function, SDA (SDA/SDI), is pin 2; GND is printed at bottom row position 3 = pin 7.
